items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: And this is Emile Q. I don't know if Emile Q is dead or not.

ctx.x: The banjo and the drum and the sax is dead.
Yes. And my son is dead. And this is Emile Q. I don't know if Emile Q is dead or not. I couldn't say.
